title.zh: 修订第708号共和国法第三编C部分第7条，涉及将外交部某些职位改设为外交官职位
title.en: An Act to Amend Section Seven, Part C, Title IIi, of Republic Act Numbered Seven Hundred Eight, Regarding Conversion of Certain Positions in the Department of Foreign Affairs to Positions of Foreign Affairs Officers
title.orig: An Act to Amend Section Seven, Part C, Title IIi, of Republic Act Numbered Seven Hundred Eight, Regarding Conversion of Certain Positions in the Department of Foreign Affairs to Positions of Foreign Affairs Officers

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1953/ra_895_1953.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。 源文条号不连续（自第 1 条起，止于第 7 条，缺 3、4、5、6）：经逐条比对原始页面，该处原文没有对应的 “Section N.” 抬头行，系来源页自身的编号跳跃或条文以“续段”形式并入前条，非抽取遗漏，故未擅自补号。

text.en:
Section seven, Part C, Title III, of Republic Act Numbered Seven hundred eight, is amended to read as follows:
"

Conversion of positions.—To permit rotation of career personnel between the Home Office and the Foreign Service, as contemplated in this Act, the positions of Counselors and the positions of chiefs of division and those of equal rank and responsibility now occupied by graduates of the Foreign Affairs Training Program in the United States Department of State are hereby converted into positions of Foreign Affairs Officers, Class I and Class II, respectively, occupying the rate in each class which the Secretary deems appropriate. The Secretary shall, by regulation, determine the manner and frequency in which Counselors, chiefs of division and occupants of positions of equal rank and responsibility shall be exchanged with Foreign Affairs Officers in the field, subject to the limitations of this Act."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 20, 1953.
